disputes.title: Malu anyi
disputes.intro: Bilumbu bia bumfumu biuvua mujule kudi bakiliya bivuabu babenge bu bintu bia muomumue. Mulombodi wa Leadrat udi utangila tshionso tshia kudibi.
disputes.empty: Kuena mujule bilumbu nansha bimue. Shi muena mudimu uudi mulue nende mubenga bu tshintu tshibidi, udi mua kubenga bualu ebu bilondeshile tshipeta tshia difunda.
disputes.withdrawConfirm: Kumbusha tshilumbu tshieba bua {{name}} ? Bumfumu bua mpindieu budi bushala anu mudibu.
disputes.raiseHint: Shi muena mudimu ewu uvua mulue kuudi kumpala, umvuije bua tshinyi. Mulombodi wa Leadrat neakonkonone bualu ebu; bobu bapangadije mu diakalenga diebe, muntu udi ukulombola udi mufunda bua bualu buebe.
disputes.reasonLabel: Bua tshinyi muena mudimu eu udi webe?
disputes.notProtected: Kakuena muntu udi ne bukubi kudi muena mudimu eu bua mudimu ewu to - udi mua kufunda muena mudimu mpindieu.
